hero.description: Dive into the crystal-clear waters of Vaavu Atoll. Experience the magic of the Indian Ocean aboard our vessel Jasmine.

about.body1: Discover Vaavu is the excursion arm of Island Break Guest House, nestled on the beautiful island of Fulidhoo in Vaavu Atoll. We bring you the finest ocean adventures the Maldives has to offer â from swimming with whale sharks to watching dolphins dance at sunset.
about.body2: Our boat Jasmine is your gateway to Vaavu's pristine reefs, hidden sandbars, and abundant marine life. Every trip is crafted to give you an authentic, unforgettable Maldivian experience.

excursions.title: Whale Shark Encounter
excursions.shortDesc: Swim alongside the ocean's gentle giants in one of the world's best whale shark destinations.
excursions.fullDesc: Join us for a once-in-a-lifetime experience swimming alongside whale sharks in the warm waters of Vaavu Atoll. Fulidhoo is one of the Maldives' premier locations for these gentle giants, and our expert guides know exactly where to find them.
excursions.note: ð¿ Seasonal availability: Best from October to April. We follow strict eco-friendly guidelines â no touching, no flash photography.

excursions.title: Dolphin Watching
excursions.shortDesc: Chase pods of spinner dolphins as they leap and play in the warm turquoise waters of Vaavu Atoll.
excursions.fullDesc: Spinner dolphins are abundant in Vaavu Atoll, and watching them leap and spin in our boat's wake is pure magic. We offer both sunrise and sunset departures for the most spectacular viewing light.
excursions.note: ð¸ Bring your camera! Spinner dolphins are extremely active and almost always put on a show.

excursions.title: Manta Ray Snorkel
excursions.shortDesc: Glide with graceful manta rays at famous cleaning stations in the heart of Vaavu Atoll.
excursions.fullDesc: Vaavu Atoll is home to famous manta ray cleaning stations where you can glide alongside these majestic creatures. Our guides know the best times and spots for guaranteed encounters.
excursions.note: ð¿ Best from November to May. Manta rays gather at cleaning stations daily â encounters are almost guaranteed in season.

excursions.title: Reef Snorkeling
excursions.shortDesc: Explore vibrant coral gardens teeming with colourful reef fish, turtles, and moray eels.
excursions.fullDesc: Dive into the crystal-clear waters of Fulidhoo's house reef and nearby dive spots. Encounter sea turtles, colourful reef fish, moray eels, and stunning coral formations in their natural habitat.
excursions.note: ð¢ Fulidhoo house reef is home to resident sea turtles â encounters are very common!

excursions.title: Sandbank Picnic
excursions.shortDesc: Step onto a deserted white-sand bank in the middle of the ocean â your own private paradise.
excursions.fullDesc: Step onto a pristine white sandbank rising from the turquoise ocean and enjoy a private picnic in the middle of the sea. This is a quintessential Maldives experience â completely secluded and absolutely breathtaking.
excursions.note: ðï¸ Sandbars shift with the tides â we scout the best one each day for your visit.

excursions.title: Sunset Cruise
excursions.shortDesc: Drift across a golden sea as the sun melts into the horizon aboard the beautiful Jasmine.
excursions.fullDesc: There's no better way to end a day in the Maldives than aboard Jasmine as the sky turns gold, orange, and pink. This relaxed cruise takes you across the lagoon to catch the most stunning sunset views.
excursions.note: ð Departure time varies by season to coincide with the golden hour â we'll confirm your exact time at booking.

excursions.title: Night Fishing
excursions.shortDesc: Try traditional Maldivian handline fishing under a canopy of stars â catch and cook on the island.
excursions.fullDesc: Experience authentic Maldivian handline fishing under a sky full of stars. Our fishermen will teach you traditional techniques, and any catch can be prepared at Island Break Guest House for a fresh fish dinner.
excursions.note: ð½ï¸ Catch-and-cook available! Any fish caught can be freshly prepared for your dinner at Island Break.

excursions.title: Island Hopping
excursions.shortDesc: Visit local islands, uninhabited nature reserves, and hidden gems only the locals know about.
excursions.fullDesc: Explore multiple islands in Vaavu Atoll in one epic day â from local inhabited islands to uninhabited nature reserves. Discover Maldivian culture, pristine beaches, and hidden gems only the locals know.
